description: Frozen validation protocol for MDSG. All claims are specified before any model results are generated on the validation corpus.

primary_confirmatory_criterion.test: lower endpoint of two-sided 95% paired task bootstrap CI > 0

C2.test: paired McNemar exact test, c > b

C3.test: count of (A fail, M success) > count of (A success, M fail)

C4.test: M redundant actions / M steps < A redundant actions / A steps

C5.test: M mean steps < A mean steps

generalization_criterion.description: The gain must not come exclusively from one task template. Report results by the four evidence categories separately. Require no catastrophic subgroup regression (no category where M success rate drops more than 10 percentage points below A).

analysis_plan.overall: paired bootstrap CI + McNemar + rescues/breaks + redundant rate + steps
analysis_plan.by_category: per-category success rates, mean utility, rescues, breaks
analysis_plan.rescue_mechanism: verify that rescues follow the READY_TO_ANSWER pattern (VERIFY, VERIFY, ANSWER vs baseline resource exhaustion)
